section.heading: Public health emergencies

subsection.heading: Determinations of emergencies
subsection.chapeau: If the Secretary determines, after consultation with such public health officials as may be necessary, that—

paragraph.content: a disease or disorder presents a public health emergency; or
a public health emergency, including significant outbreaks of infectious diseases or bioterrorist attacks, otherwise exists,

subsection.continuation: the Secretary may take such action as may be appropriate to respond to the public health emergency, including making grants, providing awards for expenses, and entering into contracts and conducting and supporting investigations into the cause, treatment, or prevention of a disease or disorder as described in paragraphs (1) and (2). Any such determination of a public health emergency terminates upon the Secretary declaring that the emergency no longer exists, or upon the expiration of the 90-day period beginning on the date on which the determination is made by the Secretary, whichever occurs first.

subsection.heading: Measures to address public health emergencies

paragraph.heading: In general
paragraph.content: A Federal agency may take such action as may be necessary to respond to a public health emergency as determined under subsection (a).

paragraph.heading: Coordination
paragraph.chapeau: The Secretary shall coordinate with relevant Federal agencies to ensure—

clause.content: State and local health departments; and

item.chapeau: medical countermeasures (as defined in section 300hh–10 of this title), including—

subclause.content: entities involved in the distribution of medical countermeasures and supplies; and

subparagraph.content: efficient allocation of resources to areas of greatest need, as determined by the Secretary pursuant to section 243 of this title.

section.sourceCredit: (July 1, 1944, ch. 373, title III, § 319, as added Pub. L. 106–505, title I, § 102, Nov. 13, 2000, 114 Stat. 2315.)

note.heading: References in Text
note.p: Section 300hh–10 of this title, referred to in subsec. (b)(2)(B)(iii)(III)(aa), was in the original "section 2811", which was translated as reading "section 2811 of the Public Health Service Act" to reflect the probable intent of Congress.
